verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents GDPR compliance for its Enterprise tier, which implies data-deletion/retention obligations are addressed at some level, and its versioning/snapshot system offers audit trails, but there is no explicit documentation of row/table deletion APIs, TTL policies, or retention configuration for AI-native users. missing for 10: explicit delete/purge API docs, data retention/TTL configuration, first-party or independent proof of deletion working as claimed.
